run_scene_optimization: run the pulsar scene optimization example that renders random spheres and optimizes them against a reference image
create_SceneModel: create a SceneModel with learnable point positions, colors, and radii rendered via PulsarPointsRenderer
test_SceneModel_forward: test the SceneModel forward method to render a point cloud scene as an image tensor
refactor_SceneModel_init: refactor the SceneModel init to customize the number of points, camera parameters, or raster settings
review_cli_optimization_loop: review the cli optimization loop that uses SGD with MSE loss to match a reference image
